script_text: Stop everything, Gemini—September's cosmic earthquake has arrived! Jupiter in Leo ignites your 8th House, squaring your Mercury-ruled mind in the 10th House. This Air-sign powerhouse forces deep career transformation through public pressures. Venus in the 6th House sextiles your natal Mars, making your work routine the ultimate love magnet. You will attract romance through professional collaboration, not casual dating apps. Saturn in Aquarius opposes your natal Sun, demanding disciplined restructuring of your 10th House reputation. A sudden financial opportunity requires strict commitment, not impulsive spending. Mars in Taurus trines your natal Venus, boosting vitality through steady exercise, though Mercury demands you pace yourself to avoid burnout. Watch September 9 and September 21 as a Full Moon and New Moon trigger career breakthroughs and emotional resolutions. Do not let fear block necessary financial risks this month.
